playoff.entries: 14th of Allsvenskan vs winner of the Superettan 3rd-v-4th tie
playoff.note: 15th and 16th are relegated directly; 14th defends its place over two legs against the winner of the Superettan 3rd-v-4th tie.
3rd hosts 4th over two legs and the winner meets the Allsvenskan 14th. Separately, 13th and 14th each play one of the two Ettan runners-up over two legs; the two ties are independent.

The winner goes up directly; the runner-up plays one of Superettan's 13th/14th over two legs. The 13th-placed club also plays a Division 2 play-off winner, and the bottom three go down (level 4 not modelled).

The winner goes up directly; the runner-up plays one of Superettan's 13th/14th over two legs. The 13th-placed club also plays a Division 2 play-off winner, and the bottom three go down (level 4 not modelled).

boundaries.note: Superettan: top 2 direct, 3rd v 4th over two legs, that winner meets the Allsvenskan 14th over two legs. Allsvenskan: 15th-16th direct down, 14th only through the shared tie. One place moves through the play-off.
Ettan: each division winner goes up directly (2); each runner-up plays one of Superettan's 13th/14th over two legs (2 more). Superettan: 15th-16th direct down, 13th-14th only through those two ties.

notes: Sweden runs calendar-year seasons, so the season overlapping the 2026-27 career year is the 2026 season (Allsvenskan 5 April - November 2026; Superettan 3 April - 7 November 2026); '2026-27' is only the dataset label. All four modelled leagues are 16-club double round robins (30 rounds). Two two-legged play-off structures: Allsvenskan 14th v Superettan 3rd/4th winner, and Superettan 13th/14th v the two Ettan runners-up (independent ties). Ettan's bottom three per division go down to Division 2 and 13th plays a Division 2 play-off, but level 4 is not modelled, hence closed_down=true for SE3N/SE3S. Reserve/farm sides can play in Ettan but not above it.
